name: coordinator
summary: Inspect bounded coordinator projections, run cycle, escalation, index, and specification-resolution operations through the validated effect boundary, and manage operator sessions and bounded questions.
usage: wt coordinator status | wt coordinator context --class=<D1|D2|D3> --trigger=<event-id> | wt coordinator explain [--cycle=<id>] | wt coordinator index <status|verify> | wt coordinator index explain <batch-or-requirement> | wt coordinator index build [--runtime] [--dry-run] | wt coordinator cycle --trigger=<event-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator escalate --reason=<text> [--cycle=<id>] [--dry-run] | wt coordinator resolution show <blocker-id> | wt coordinator resolution <propose|resume> <blocker-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator resolution sync-check <blocker-id> --worktree=<id> | wt coordinator session --topic=<text> [--policy-profile=<id>] [--stream|--no-stream] | wt coordinator session attach <id> [--observe] [--stream|--no-stream] [--wait-for-active-turn] | wt coordinator session list | wt coordinator session <show|history|export|budget|proposals> <id> [--since=<cursor>] | wt coordinator session <suspend|resume|close|prune|fork|compact> <id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session <pin|unpin> <id> <ref> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session apply <id> <proposal-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session amendment request <id> --pack=<id> --reason=<text> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session amendment list | wt coordinator session amendment admit <request-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator ask --question=<text> --session=<id> [--query-form=<id>]; every form also accepts [--workspace=<path>] [--lane=<slug-or-uuid>] [--initiative=<id>] [--json] [--no-color]

flags.name: workspace
flags.description: Resolve the lane from this existing path.

flags.name: lane
flags.description: Select one relevant lane by exact ID or slug.

flags.name: initiative
flags.description: Select an initiative.

flags.name: runtime
flags.description: Apply runtime-index rebuild through the validated mutation boundary.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Preview the planned effect without writing, invoking, or mutating.

flags.name: class
flags.description: Required decision class for context: D1, D2, or D3.

flags.name: trigger
flags.description: Exact trigger event ID for context or a coordinator cycle.

flags.name: cycle
flags.description: Explain or escalate one exact cycle ID.

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit the versioned command-result envelope.

flags.name: no-color
flags.description: Disable ANSI color.

flags.name: reason
flags.description: Required escalation reason; must match the authorized proposal exactly.

flags.name: worktree
flags.description: Worktree identity for resolution sync-check.

flags.name: topic
flags.description: Topic for a new or forked operator session.

flags.name: policy-profile
flags.description: Operator-session policy profile for a new or forked session.

flags.name: observe
flags.description: Attach read-only; an observer appends no turn and holds no lock.

flags.name: stream
flags.description: Stream provisional turn output where the terminal supports it.

flags.name: no-stream
flags.description: Disable provisional streaming for this attachment.

flags.name: wait-for-active-turn
flags.description: Wait for another attachment’s active turn instead of refusing.

flags.name: since
flags.description: Resume a bounded history or export page from this cursor.

flags.name: pack
flags.description: Pack identity for an amendment request.

flags.name: question
flags.description: The exact bounded question `ask` answers.

flags.name: query-form
flags.description: Registered structured-query form id; only a registered form reaches M0.

flags.name: session
flags.description: Operator session `ask` answers within.
